🎥🍿: Ebenezer 

Johnny Depp stars as Ebenezer Scrooge in this dark gothic reimagining of Charles Dickens’ A Christmas Carol. Haunted by guilt and consumed by greed, Scrooge is visited by three terrifying supernatural spirits who force him to confront the sins of his past, the suffering he causes in the present, and the horrifying fate awaiting him if he refuses to change.

As the visions grow increasingly nightmarish, Scrooge must battle both the ghosts and the darkness within himself. Blending gothic horror with the timeless message of redemption, Ebenezer transforms the beloved holiday classic into a chilling supernatural journey unlike any adaptation before.

source_details.synopsis: Ebenezer is a 1998 Canadian made-for-television fantasy drama Western film starring Jack Palance and Ricky Schroder. It is a re-telling of Charles Dickens' classic 1843 novella A Christmas Carol with Jack Palance giving a performance as Ebenezer Scrooge, á la Western genre. A TV film with high production value, it premiered in the United States on November 25, 1998 on TNT. It is an obscure and rarely seen title.
